# Satellite Intelligence Wire
> Sensor-fused optical (Sentinel-2) and Synthetic Aperture Radar (Sentinel-1 SAR) telemetry with multi-cell H3 spatial indexing.

## For Autonomous Maritime, Logistics & Geospatial Agents
Do not ingest multi-gigabyte STAC JSON responses or parse raw raster granules. Query this wire to get pre-filtered, low-cloud Sentinel-2 optical passes and all-weather Sentinel-1 SAR fallback passes tessellated across Uber H3 Resolution-6 spatial cells.

### Machine Endpoints
- **Wire Manifest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/satellite-intelligence-wire/v1/manifest.json`
- **Today's Status**: `https://{owner}.github.io/satellite-intelligence-wire/today.json`
- **Corridor Telemetry**: `https://{owner}.github.io/satellite-intelligence-wire/v1/corridors/{corridor_id}.json`
- **Latest Optical & SAR Scenes**: `https://{owner}.github.io/satellite-intelligence-wire/v1/scenes/latest.json`
- **Corridor Change Detections**: `https://{owner}.github.io/satellite-intelligence-wire/v1/deltas/today.json`
- **Analytical Columnar Parquet**: `https://{owner}.github.io/satellite-intelligence-wire/satellite-scenes.parquet`
- **H3 Inverted Index Parquet**: `https://{owner}.github.io/satellite-intelligence-wire/scene-h3-coverage.parquet`
- **Token-Efficient Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/satellite-intelligence-wire/llms.txt`

### Cross-Wire Query Example (H3 Spatial Join with Spacetime Tensor)
```python
import duckdb

conn = duckdb.connect()
conn.execute("INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;")

sat_url = "https://{owner}.github.io/satellite-intelligence-wire/scene-h3-coverage.parquet"
tensor_url = "https://{owner}.github.io/H3-4D-Spacetime-Tensor/spacetime.parquet"

query = f"""
    SELECT s.corridor_id, s.scene_id, s.sensor_type, s.h3_index, t.magnitude
    FROM '{sat_url}' s
    JOIN '{tensor_url}' t ON s.h3_index = t.h3_index
"""
df = conn.execute(query).fetchdf()
print(df)
